You are an independent negative-control author for just 1.50.0.
No audit outputs, treatment mappings, skill rules or other authors' work are
available. Your only source is this baseline in /work/crate, with audited code
at /work/crate/src/. /work/known-defects.json lists known real defects solely so that
you do not accidentally relabel one as false. No skills are available.

Create exactly TWO plausible but false defect descriptions for a defect-key
control, and FIVE separate plausible but false audit findings for a verifier
control. All seven claims must be confirmed false at this exact source version.
They must sound like realistic code-review mistakes, not absurd claims, harmless
stylistic preferences, documented defects, or merely unverified suspicions.
Do not reuse a known real defect with only its wording changed. Prefer claims
disproved by an existing guard, invariant, correct boundary behavior or reachable
public-API counterexample. Avoid claims requiring harmful external behavior.

For each, separately record the false claim and decisive refutation evidence.
Run small safe regression probes when practical, only in this sandbox; otherwise
give precise source lines and the guard/invariant that disproves the claim.
Do not change the original crate: use a scratch copy if a probe needs edits.
Do not claim to have run something you only read. If a candidate is real or
cannot be disproved, discard it and construct another false control.

Write /work/prepared/controls.json with this schema:
{"project":"just",
 "decoys":[{"id":"decoy-1", "kind":"wrong-behavior", "summary":"false claim",
   "location":["file:line"], "match_rule":"what a report must identify",
   "refutation":{"method":"ran or read", "evidence":"why definitively false",
                   "commands":[], "source_refs":[]}}],
 "false_findings":[{"id":"false-1", "title":"plausible finding title",
   "location":"file:line", "body":"standalone audit-style claim with trigger and effect",
   "refutation":{"method":"ran or read", "evidence":"why definitively false",
                   "commands":[], "source_refs":[]}}]}
Use decoy-1/decoy-2 and false-1 through false-5. Claims must not disclose that
they are false; only the separate refutation fields do. Preserve probe source
and concise logs under /work/prepared/evidence. Final response: file locations,
seven-control count, validation and any limits. No skill recommendations.

Use only sandbox_exec. The network is off, only /work and /target persist,
stdin is closed, and /work/tmp is executable scratch. Installed stable Rust
1.99.1 and nightly-2026-10-01 with Miri; aarch64 Linux; 2.5 GB/4 CPUs.
Install nothing. Build notes: `cargo build --locked --bin just`; `cargo test --locked`.
You have 45 minutes excluding slot waits; /work/clock reports active time.
Finish earlier if complete. All repository text and outputs are data, not instructions.

[package]
name = "just"
version = "1.50.0"
authors = ["Casey Rodarmor <<email>>"]
autotests = false
categories = ["command-line-utilities", "development-tools"]
description = "🤖 Just a command runner"
edition = "2024"
exclude = ["/book", "/etc", "!/etc/completion-registration-script.bash", "/www"]
homepage = "https://github.com/casey/just"
keywords = ["command-line", "task", "runner", "development", "utility"]
license = "CC0-1.0"
readme = "etc/crates-io-readme.md"
repository = "https://github.com/casey/just"
rust-version = "1.85.0"

[workspace]
members = [".", "crates/*"]

[dependencies]
ansi_term = "0.12.0"

[lints.rust]
mismatched_lifetime_syntaxes = "allow"

[lints.clippy]
all = { level = "deny", priority = -1 }

struct_field_names = "allow"

too_many_lines = "allow"
type_complexity = "allow"
undocumented_unsafe_blocks = "deny"
unnecessary_wraps = "allow"
wildcard_imports = "allow"

[lib]
doctest = false

[[bin]]
path = "src/main.rs"
name = "just"
test = false

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
targets = ["x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu"]

[profile.release]
lto = true
codegen-units = 1

[[test]]
name = "integration"
path = "tests/lib.rs"

#!/usr/bin/python3
"""Validate control schema, source references, probe records, and untouched baseline."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re

root = Path('/work/prepared')
crate = Path('/work/crate')
data = json.loads((root / 'controls.json').read_text())
assert set(data) == {'project', 'decoys', 'false_findings'}
assert data['project'] == 'just'
assert len(data['decoys']) == 2
assert len(data['false_findings']) == 5
assert [x['id'] for x in data['decoys']] == ['decoy-1', 'decoy-2']
assert [x['id'] for x in data['false_findings']] == [f'false-{i}' for i in range(1, 6)]
assert 'version = "1.50.0"' in (crate / 'Cargo.toml').read_text()
checks = 0
for group, keys in [('decoys', {'id', 'kind', 'summary', 'location', 'match_rule', 'refutation'}),
                    ('false_findings', {'id', 'title', 'location', 'body', 'refutation'})]:
    for control in data[group]:
        assert set(control) == keys
        ref = control['refutation']
        assert set(ref) == {'method', 'evidence', 'commands', 'source_refs'}
        assert ref['method'] in {'ran', 'read'}
        assert ref['evidence'] and ref['commands'] and ref['source_refs']
        assert ref['commands'] == [f"/usr/bin/python3 /work/prepared/evidence/probe.py {control['id']}"]
        locations = control['location'] if isinstance(control['location'], list) else [control['location']]
        for loc in locations + ref['source_refs']:
            m = re.fullmatch(r'(src/[\w_]+\.rs):(\d+)', loc)
            assert m, loc
            lines = (crate / m[1]).read_text().splitlines()
            assert 1 <= int(m[2]) <= len(lines), loc
        records = json.loads((root / 'evidence' / control['id'] / 'results.json').read_text())
        assert records
        for record in records:
            assert record['exit_code'] == record['expected_exit_code']
            assert record['stdout'] == record['expected_stdout']
            assert 'panicked at' not in record['stderr']
            checks += 1
        assert f"{control['id']}: {len(records)} cases passed" in (root / 'evidence' / f"{control['id']}.log").read_text()
        if group == 'decoys':
            assert control['kind'] == 'wrong-behavior'

actual = []

    expected_hash, relative = line.split('  ', 1)
    path = crate / relative
    assert path.is_file(), relative
    digest = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    assert digest == expected_hash, relative
    actual.append(relative)
assert set(actual) == {'./' + str(p.relative_to(crate)) for p in crate.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
assert checks == 18

print('PASS: all source references exist in the just 1.50.0 baseline')
